description: Branch D, deciding variant: And/Or results as a validation consumer. Tables Va0 (rule [V] > 0 And [V] < 10), Va1 (rule [V] > 0 Or [V] < -5) and Va2 (rule ([V] > 0) And Null) each get V = 5, -1, 15, -7 and Null on a newly opened table recordset (AddNew, put, Update); Errors after each put and each Update and EditMode after Update. Required and AllowZeroLength are left at their defaults. Follow-up probe (status F) for Branch D, EXPR-MUTATION; runs on a writable fresh copy of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
